notes: Histories downloaded with the original plotting scripts: up to 1200 sampled rows per seed; 800-point interpolation and 95% normal confidence bands.
These fixed curves reproduce the paper figures; fresh training is stochastic.

Historical PQN code drew an unrecorded Python-random seed despite SEED=7 in its config. The release uses the configured JAX seed deterministically. PQN uses a 20M decay schedule; the plotted curve stops at 10M steps.
